title: Dimension at a point of a finite type algebra over a field
statement: Let $k$ be a field, $S$ a finite type $k$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra] and $\mathfrak p\subset S$ a prime ideal, with localization $S_{\mathfrak p}$ and residue field $\kappa(\mathfrak p)$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime], a field extension of $k$ [def-pc-field-extension]. Let $\dim_{\mathfrak p}(\operatorname{Spec}S)$ be the Krull dimension of the topological space $\operatorname{Spec}S$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] at the point $\mathfrak p$ [def-kun-topological-dimension-at-point], $\dim S_{\mathfrak p}$ the Krull dimension of the ring $S_{\mathfrak p}$ [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring] and $\operatorname{trdeg}_k\kappa(\mathfrak p)$ the transcendence degree [def-kun-transcendence-degree]. Then all three are finite and $$\dim_{\mathfrak p}(\operatorname{Spec}S)=\dim S_{\mathfrak p}+\operatorname{trdeg}_k\kappa(\mathfrak p).$$

proof.text: Since S is finite type over a field, Algebra.FiniteType.isNoetherianRing makes S and its localization S_p Noetherian. Mathlib's Noetherian-local-ring FiniteRingKrullDim instance excludes both bottom and top. WithBot.ne_bot_iff_exists and ENat.ne_top_iff_exists supply a natural d with dim S_p = d. The residue field is essentially finite type over k by Algebra.EssFiniteType.comp; the FinTrdeg instance and trdeg_lt_aleph0, followed by Cardinal.lt_aleph0, supply r with trdeg_k kappa(p) = r. These finiteness arguments use only Mathlib, not a new hole.
Apply [lem-weil-pbc-minimal-component-dimension-maximum] to d and r: the dimensions of every minimal component S/q through p are bounded by d+r and one attains d+r.

Apply [lem-weil-pbc-dimension-at-point-components] to get a finite set of exactly the minimal primes below p and a natural n equal to dim_p Spec S, bounding all component dimensions and attained by one component. The attaining component for n gives n <= d+r. The component attaining d+r gives d+r <= n. Antisymmetry gives n=d+r, hence the unchanged target.
